name: Atlantic salmon
definition: Whole fish or cuts of the salmon Salmo salar sold raw.

name: Sockeye salmon
definition: Raw red salmon of the Pacific, Oncorhynchus nerka, sold apart from other salmon.

name: Coho salmon
definition: Raw Pacific salmon Oncorhynchus kisutch.

name: King (chinook) salmon
definition: Raw Pacific salmon Oncorhynchus tshawytscha, the largest salmon.

name: Chum (keta) salmon
definition: Raw Pacific salmon Oncorhynchus keta.

name: Rainbow trout
definition: Raw freshwater trout Oncorhynchus mykiss.

name: Arctic char [Saibling]
definition: Raw char of the genus Salvelinus, a cold-water relative of salmon and trout.

name: Cod [Kabeljau]
definition: Raw Atlantic or Pacific cod of the genus Gadus.

name: Haddock
definition: Raw haddock, Melanogrammus aeglefinus.

name: Pollock (saithe) [Seelachs]
definition: Raw pollock or saithe (Pollachius virens, Gadus chalcogrammus), sold as white fish.

name: Hake
definition: Raw hake of the genus Merluccius.

name: European sea bass [Wolfsbarsch]
definition: Raw sea bass, Dicentrarchus labrax.

name: Gilthead sea bream [Dorade]
definition: Raw sea bream, Sparus aurata.

name: Barramundi
definition: Raw barramundi, Lates calcarifer.

name: Plaice [Scholle]
definition: Raw flatfish Pleuronectes platessa.

name: Halibut [Heilbutt]
definition: Raw large flatfish of the genus Hippoglossus.

name: Monkfish [Seeteufel]
definition: Raw monkfish or anglerfish of the genus Lophius.

name: Bluefin tuna
definition: Raw bluefin tuna of the genus Thunnus, sold whole or in cuts.

name: Yellowfin tuna
definition: Raw tuna Thunnus albacares.

name: Swordfish
definition: Raw swordfish, Xiphias gladius.

name: Mackerel
definition: Raw mackerel of the genus Scomber.

name: Herring
definition: Raw herring, Clupea harengus and relatives; a whole herring sold with its roe inside is this kind.

name: Sardine
definition: Raw sardine or pilchard, Sardina pilchardus and relatives.

name: Prawn or shrimp, species not stated
definition: Prawn or shrimp whose pack does not name the species; the first kind and the fallback for unnamed prawns.

name: Banana prawn
definition: Prawn sold under the trade name banana prawn (a trade name that may cover several species).

name: King prawn
definition: Prawn sold under the trade name king prawn (a trade name that may cover several species).

name: Langoustine
definition: Small clawed lobster Nephrops norvegicus, sold whole or as tails.

name: Lobster
definition: Clawed or spiny lobster sold for eating.

name: Crab (edible crab and others)
definition: Crab sold for eating, whole or as white or brown meat.

name: Oyster
definition: Oyster sold for eating, live in the shell or shucked.

name: Mussel
definition: Mussel sold for eating, live in the shell or shelled.

name: Scallop
definition: Scallop sold for eating, in the shell or as the adductor muscle with or without roe.

name: Squid
definition: Squid sold for eating, whole, in tubes or in rings.

name: Octopus
definition: Octopus sold for eating.

name: Abalone
definition: Abalone sold for eating, live, chilled or frozen.

name: Sea cucumber
definition: Sea cucumber sold fresh or frozen for eating.

name: Sea urchin [uni]
definition: Sea urchin sold whole or as the gonads (uni) for eating.

name: Mixed seafood
definition: A mix of seafood kinds sold as one product, where no single kind makes up half or more of the weight (P6).

name: Smoked salmon (cold-smoked)
definition: Salmon cured and smoked at low temperature, sold sliced or in pieces, ready to eat without cooking.

name: Hot-smoked salmon
definition: Salmon smoked at a temperature that cooks it, sold as fillets, portions or flakes.

name: Smoked trout
definition: Trout smoked cold or hot, sold as fillets or whole fish.

name: Smoked mackerel
definition: Mackerel smoked cold or hot, sold as fillets or whole fish.

name: Smoked herring
definition: Herring split or whole and smoked.

name: Smoked eel [Räucheraal]
definition: Eel smoked whole or in pieces.

name: Smoked dogfish belly [Schillerlocke]
definition: Smoked belly flaps of dogfish; the German word is a regional name with no generic kind of its own, and its level is provisional until attested.

name: Salt cod
definition: Cod preserved by salting and drying, sold to be soaked and cooked.

name: Salted herring
definition: Herring cured in brine or salt and sold chilled, to be eaten as the fish itself.

name: Dried scallop [干贝]
definition: Scallop adductor muscle dried for eating or cooking.

name: Dried shrimp [虾米]
definition: Shrimp dried whole or shelled for eating or cooking.

name: Dried squid [鱿鱼干]
definition: Squid dried whole, in pieces or in shreds.

name: Dried sea cucumber [刺参]
definition: Sea cucumber dried for rehydrating and cooking.

name: Salted-fermented seafood, whole or in pieces [jeotgal; shiokara; bagoong]
definition: Whole or cut seafood preserved by salting and fermenting and sold to be eaten as the seafood itself; a paste or sauce is J5.

name: Tinned tuna
definition: Tuna packed in a sealed tin, jar or pouch that keeps it shelf-stable.

name: Tinned sardines
definition: Sardines packed in a sealed tin or jar.

name: Tinned crab meat
definition: Crab meat packed in a sealed tin or jar.

name: Marinated herring
definition: Herring marinated in vinegar, oil or a sauce and sold in a jar or tub.

name: Beluga caviar
definition: Roe of the beluga sturgeon Huso huso, sold as grain caviar.

name: Osetra caviar
definition: Roe of Acipenser gueldenstaedtii and related osetra sturgeon, sold as grain caviar.

name: Sevruga caviar
definition: Roe of the sevruga sturgeon Acipenser stellatus, sold as grain caviar.

name: Pressed caviar
definition: Sturgeon roe pressed into a mass instead of sold as separate grains, including mixed-species roe.

name: Salmon roe [ikura]
definition: Roe of salmon, whole eggs sold loose or marinated.

name: Trout roe
definition: Roe of trout, sold fresh, cured or smoked.

name: Lumpfish roe
definition: Roe of the lumpfish Cyclopterus lumpus, sold as small dyed or natural eggs.

name: Flying-fish roe [tobiko]
definition: Roe of flying fish, small crunchy eggs.

name: Surimi stick (crab stick)
definition: Stick of formed and seasoned fish paste, not coated, filled or sauced.

name: Kamaboko
definition: Steamed, formed cake of fish paste.

name: Chikuwa
definition: Tube of fish paste cooked on a rod or by roasting.

name: Fish ball
definition: Round ball of ground fish paste, not coated, filled or sauced.

name: Fish sausage
definition: Sausage-shaped formed fish paste in a casing.

name: Fish pâté or terrine (sold as a loaf or slice)
definition: Pâté, terrine or galantine of fish sold as a loaf or slice to be cut; a spread or dip in a jar or tub is J5.
